add.title: Session.apply_line: skip line keys before the bare-id walk, as Task.replay_line does with LINE_KEYS
add.why: Since worktree/qf3-work-tab (41beff918) a bare id resolves at any depth; Session has no verb guard, so a nested task whose id equals a line key (merge, review, log) would swallow that line. No session has both today (one task id 'merge' in 2026/09/20/approve-loop, no merge lines). Fix: export LINE_KEYS from core/Task/Task.js and skip them in Session's loop at Session.js:93.

add.title: SessionTasks: skip the task-list redraw when a streamed batch changed no task
add.why: Measured by data-shapes integration 2 (check 6) on v-sq8y7db (8,360 lines, 664 task rows): 40 dictation chat lines at 4 a second gave 40 full redraws of the list, median 94 ms each (max 154), about 40% of the main thread while dictating. A chat line changes no task. Cheaper than michael/dev (which also replays the whole record per batch, about 130 ms more), so not a regression. Fix idea: compare the tasks' ids, states and titles before and after the batch, and redraw the list only when they differ (rows redraw themselves on their own change). Proof: /framework/core/Session/tasks/data-shapes/build/integration-2/proof/voice.txt on branch integration/data-shapes-2.

add.title: Roll child session cost up to a VS Code tab parent by its uuid, not only by agent id
add.why: Tab e00f55c9 shows $645 with 0 children: its children record parent "vscode-mastermind" (an agent id), which the rollup never matches to the tab's uuid (mastermind-session-map report, 2026-11-06).

add.title: Refuse or split two sessions writing one record folder
add.why: Sessions 8d452ffd and 7e6b7107 share one record folder, so their lines, costs and tasks mix (mastermind-session-map report, 2026-11-06).
